description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableSortOptionEntry implementing the SortOptionEntry interface, representing sorting options with a property path and sort order.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry
classes.description: Immutable implementation of SortOptionEntry with methods for creating ascending and descending sort options.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSortOptionEntry with specified propertyPath and sortOrder.

methods.name: asc
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSortOptionEntry with ascending order for the given propertyPath.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSortOptionEntry with descending order for the given propertyPath.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path associated with this sort option.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order (ascending or descending).
